title: Beyond Single-Turn: A Survey on Multi-Turn Interactions with Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Attribute Bias (Age, Gender, Race, Religion, Disability, Appearance)
bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing benchmarks (such as FairMT-Bench) that measure stereotypes and toxicity in multi-turn dialogues to evaluate how biases accumulate and amplify across sequential conversational turns.
Analyzing systematic biases in LLM-as-a-judge frameworks where automated evaluators unfairly favor outputs from models with similar architectural lineage or reward unnecessarily long responses.

Reviewing medical adversarial robustness benchmarks (like MedFuzz) that introduce ambiguous patient traits and biased data to expose vulnerabilities to demographic stereotypes and clinical biases in multi-turn medical QA.
